name: S1 · Demo: four students pick a project topic (Jiwoo's perspective)
goal: Pick one topic for our team project

steps.title: T1 · Jiwoo and Taeho think privately. Expected: agents reply privately, nothing in the group.
steps.text: I want to predict how crowded the cafeteria and library are, using campus data. Not sure it is good enough to share.
Wi-Fi access counts for every building are public data. Keep that in mind.

steps.title: T2 · Two similar ideas, then silence. Expected: moderator picks an angle; only Jiwoo and Taeho get a share card.
steps.text: How about a study group matching app?
A chatbot for club recruiting could work too.

steps.fallback: What about predicting how crowded the cafeteria and library are?
Wi-Fi access counts could measure that. They are public.

steps.title: T3 · A decision. Expected: check opens; answers split 2/2; moderator posts one anonymous question.
steps.text: Nice. Let's go with crowding prediction then.

steps.title: T3 · The team narrows the scope. The host revises the proposal (version 2). Expected: Agreed 4/4.
steps.text: OK, let's just do the library and the cafeteria.
We will predict crowding in the library and the cafeteria only.
